# axm skills uninstall

Uninstall a skill from agents

## When to use

Uninstall a skill from agents

## Usage

```bash
axm skills uninstall [flags] <skill>
```

## Arguments

| Name    | Type   | Required | Description                    |
| ------- | ------ | -------- | ------------------------------ |
| `skill` | string | Yes      | Name of the skill to uninstall |

## Flags

| Name            | Type    | Required | Description                                          |
| --------------- | ------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `--yes`, `-y`   | boolean | No       | Skip the 'are you sure?' confirmation                |
| `--force`, `-f` | boolean | No       | Remove even if other extensions depend on this skill |
| `--preview`     | boolean | No       | Show what would be removed without making changes    |

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](../global-flags).

## Examples

**Remove a skill you no longer need**

```bash
axm skills uninstall my-skill
```

**Check what would be removed first**

```bash
axm skills uninstall my-skill --preview
```

**Remove without confirmation (scripts/CI)**

```bash
axm skills uninstall my-skill --yes
```

## Requirements

None.

## Side effects

None.
